explain: Choose metrics and tools from the product's required evidence. The contract distinguishes deterministic permission checks from judged answer support.
steps: State success and failure criteria first. || Select a metric implementation only after identifying the inputs it requires.
name: evaluation-contract

explain: Precision counts relevant returned items, recall counts relevant items found, and reciprocal rank uses the first relevant position. Labels here are document identities.
steps: Find the positions of relevant hits in the ranking. || Calculate each metric using its own denominator.
name: retrieval-metrics

explain: A regression case captures a minimal synthetic reproduction and its expected invariant, avoiding unnecessary production payload collection.
steps: Store input, configuration identity, observed failure, and expected behavior. || Validate the case is sufficient to rerun the boundary check.
name: failure-artifact

explain: Liveness, readiness, and degraded quality answer different questions. A running process can be unready to accept work even while its liveness probe passes.
steps: Record process, dependency, and freshness signals separately. || Compute admission readiness without calling it end-to-end answer quality.
name: health-levels

explain: Aggregate quality can shift because the task mix changed or because one slice regressed. Track category counts and outcomes instead of only the global mean.
steps: Keep a baseline rate for the same task slice. || Flag the observed drop for investigation rather than declaring its cause.
name: drift-monitor
